title: Projects
subtitle: Each project is a completely separate set of vendors, ledgers, budgets, orders and records. Users, logins and PINs are shared by all projects.
emptyNote: A new project starts completely empty — nothing is copied from another project.
codeHint: 2–6 letters/digits. It prefixes every document number (e.g. ABC-PO001) and cannot be changed later.
name: Project name
okCreated: Project created. Use the project menu in the top bar to open it.
codeInvalid: Code must be 2–6 letters or digits, starting with a letter
archiveConfirm: Archive “{{name}}”? It will disappear from the login page. Its data is kept and it can be restored.
